clue.text: Contacting a head in syndicate

indicators.note: one thing set in another is placed inside it, so one piece sits within the other

parts.note: a ring is a group working together, such as a criminal syndicate
'a head' as in 'five pounds a head', meaning per person

explanation.surface: Getting in touch with one of the bosses of a crime syndicate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A head' is the pricing phrase 'per head', so it means each, not a leader.
explanation.definitionFit: Reaching someone is getting through to them by phone or message, a synonym of contacting.

clue.text: Drunk reposes after consuming second strong drink

indicators.note: something consumed is taken inside, so one piece goes into the other
a drunk is unsteady and muddled, so the letters lose their order

parts.note: taken as written
S is the standard abbreviation for second

explanation.surface: A tipsy person dozes off after downing a second stiff drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Strong drink' suggests spirits, but here it is strong coffee.
explanation.definitionFit: An espresso is a small, concentrated shot of coffee, so a strong drink in the caffeine sense.

clue.text: Environmental issue has two characters in conversation switching positions

indicators.note: letters that swap places produce a rearranged word, here only two of them moving

parts.note: the word itself, in which two letters will trade places

explanation.surface: A green topic under discussion, with two people in a talk swapping seats.
explanation.walkthrough: Swap the V and the S in the word conversation and the new word appears.
explanation.definitionFit: Conservation, the protection of nature and wildlife, is a leading concern of environmental politics.

clue.text: Almost transfix a graceful antelope

indicators.note: almost means not quite all, so the final letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: to impale is to pierce through, to transfix
taken as written

explanation.surface: A hunter nearly spears an elegant antelope.
explanation.definitionFit: The impala is a slender, leaping African antelope noted for its elegance.

clue.text: Yield to pressure and donate

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to bend or collapse when pushed
second meaning: to hand over as a gift

explanation.surface: Someone is pressed into making a charitable contribution.
explanation.definitionFit: A floor can give under weight, and a person can give money to charity: two senses of one verb.

clue.text: Outstanding moment, greeting said spy

indicators.note: said means spoken, so the greeting counts for its sound rather than its spelling

parts.note: hi is a greeting, and high sounds the same
to spy something is to spot it

explanation.surface: A thrilling instant in a spy story, as the agent is greeted.
explanation.definitionFit: A high spot is the best or most memorable part of an event, its standout moment.

clue.text: Fish or beef

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a freshwater fish
second meaning: to complain, as in 'what's your beef?'

explanation.surface: A menu choice between fish and beef.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Beef' reads as meat, but here it is a verb for grumbling.
explanation.definitionFit: The carp is a common pond fish, and to carp is to complain, which is what beefing means in slang.

clue.text: Unequalled, like the House of Commons

definitions.meaning: first meaning: without any rival
second meaning, read literally: having no members of the nobility

explanation.surface: A boast that the lower chamber of Parliament has no equal.
explanation.walkthrough: Peers, the hereditary and appointed nobility, sit in the House of Lords; the Commons is the elected chamber without them.
explanation.definitionFit: Peerless normally means having no equal; split as peer-less it describes a body lacking lords.

clue.text: Begin minimal account of my visit to restaurant?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to start something off

definitions.text: minimal account of my visit to restaurant
definitions.meaning: second meaning, cryptic: the shortest diner's report, four tiny words run together

explanation.surface: Starting a terse review of a dinner out.
explanation.walkthrough: Split it as 'In it I ate': all a minimal diner's report needs. The question mark flags the whimsy.
explanation.definitionFit: To initiate something is to start or launch it, so it is a synonym of begin.

clue.text: Turn that certain doctors can deal with?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a rotation

definitions.text: that certain doctors can deal with
definitions.meaning: second meaning: what ... doctors, political media handlers, put on a story

explanation.surface: Asking whether a fit of dizziness is something particular doctors treat.
explanation.walkthrough: The doctors are not medical: spin doctors are press advisers who present news favourably.
explanation.definitionFit: A spin is a rapid rotation, and it is also the favourable slant that press advisers give to news.

clue.text: Spectators may pick it up, but not other players, it seems

definitions.text: Spectators may pick it up, but not other players, it seems

parts.words: Spectators may pick it up, but not other players
parts.note: surface reading: something in a sports match that the crowd notices but the rest of the team misses
setter's reading: in a theatre, a remark the audience is meant to hear while the other actors pretend not to

explanation.walkthrough: Spectators and players suggest sport; they are a theatre audience and actors, and 'it seems' marks the pretence.
explanation.definitionFit: A loud aside spoken on stage, audible to the audience but by convention unheard by the other characters.

clue.text: Son currently joining coach, say, for winter sport

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for son
now means at present
getting on a coach or other vehicle is boarding it; 'say' marks it as one example

explanation.surface: A son is just now getting on the coach for a ski trip.
explanation.definitionFit: Riding down snowy slopes on a single wide board is a popular winter sport.

clue.text: Measure badly needed about new form of identification

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the jumbled letters go round the other piece
something done badly is botched, so the letters end up out of order

parts.note: taken as written
N is the abbreviation for new

explanation.surface: A clumsy measurement is needed for some new identity document.
explanation.definitionFit: A username is the handle by which a computer system identifies an account holder at login.

clue.text: It's defined as 'official order' in one dictionary

indicators.note: in says the letters sit inside the words that follow, spanning the gap between them

parts.note: the last letter of the first word and the start of the second

explanation.surface: A dictionary entry gives a word's meaning as 'official order'.
explanation.walkthrough: The run starts at the last letter of 'one' and takes the first four of 'dictionary'.
explanation.definitionFit: An edict is a decree issued by an authority, such as a ruler, an official order.

clue.text: Dog hiding its lead in South Coast resort

indicators.note: something hidden is tucked away inside, so one piece goes into the other

parts.note: Poole is a seaside town in Dorset on England's south coast

indicators.note: a lead is what goes in front, so only the opening letter of the dog is used

parts.note: 'its' refers back to the dog, whose first letter is wanted

explanation.surface: A dog with its leash concealed in a seaside town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lead' looks like a dog leash, but it means the first letter of 'Dog'.
explanation.definitionFit: The poodle is a curly-coated breed of dog.

clue.text: Spanish artist unknown in part of India

indicators.note: in places one piece inside the other

parts.note: Goa is a state on India's west coast
y is a mathematical unknown

explanation.surface: An obscure Spanish painter living somewhere in India.
explanation.definitionFit: Francisco Goya was a celebrated Spanish painter of the late eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries.

clue.text: Threatened to go out as leader of government spoke

indicators.note: the leader is the front one, so just the opening letter of the next word is used

parts.note: the first letter of government
uttered means said or spoke

explanation.surface: A prime minister's speech hints at being ousted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Threatened to go out' suggests losing power; it describes a candle flame flickering.
explanation.definitionFit: A candle that gutters flickers and burns low, close to being extinguished.

clue.text: Be rude, in a way? That's characteristic

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to direct a finger at someone, often thought impolite
second meaning: a feature or trait

explanation.surface: Someone remarks that being rude is typical of a person.
explanation.definitionFit: Pointing at people is considered bad manners, and a point is also a quality or attribute of someone.

clue.text: Pitiful way quote's brought up

parts.note: a path is a way

indicators.note: in a down entry, raising something turns it to read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: to cite is to quote

explanation.surface: A sad way that some quotation is raised in conversation.
explanation.definitionFit: Pathetic means arousing pity, or contemptibly weak, the same as pitiful.

clue.text: Superior blouses, evenly cut

indicators.note: cutting the even positions keeps only the odd-numbered letters

parts.note: the first, third, fifth and seventh letters

explanation.surface: Fancy blouses with neatly trimmed hems.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Evenly cut' sounds like tailoring; it means removing letters two, four and six.
explanation.definitionFit: Your superior at work is the person above you, your boss.

clue.text: You're currently producing this liquid mixture

definitions.meaning: first meaning: what the solver is working out right now
second meaning: a substance dissolved in a fluid

explanation.surface: Someone is told they are making a liquid blend at this moment.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'you' is the solver: what you are producing as you fill this grid is the answer to the clue.
explanation.definitionFit: A solution is the answer to a puzzle and also a liquid in which something is dissolved.

clue.text: On coast, it grows economy

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a pink-flowered plant of seaside cliffs
second meaning: careful use of money

explanation.surface: A seaside town's economy is growing.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests the economy grows on the coast; the plant thrift, or sea pink, is what grows there.
explanation.definitionFit: Thrift is frugality with money, and also the name of a tufted coastal flower.

clue.text: Broken seat belt OK for checking

indicators.note: a broken thing has been smashed apart, so these letters are put back together differently

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A mechanic finds a broken seat belt acceptable on inspection.
explanation.definitionFit: Something testable can be examined or tried out, so it is suitable for checking.

clue.text: Part of fiddle or racket

definitions.meaning: first meaning: one of the strands a violin bow is drawn across
second meaning: the mesh of a tennis racket is strung

explanation.surface: Something is either a swindle or a scam, both slang words for fraud.
explanation.walkthrough: Fiddle and racket both read as cons; they are a violin and a tennis racket, each of which has strings.
explanation.definitionFit: A violin has strings, and so does a tennis racket's woven face, so the word is a part of each.

clue.text: Editor initially prevented me changing what's composed

indicators.note: changing alters the order, so these letters are rearranged
initially points to the very first letter of the word before it

parts.note: the first letter of editor
taken as written

explanation.surface: An editor stopped a writer from altering a finished piece of writing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Composed' suggests written work, but it means calm.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone even-tempered stays calm and placid, which is what composed means of a person.

clue.text: Scene of first expulsion for Etonian who became PM

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the garden from which Adam and Eve were driven out
second meaning: Anthony, British prime minister 1955 to 1957, educated at Eton

explanation.surface: A schoolboy at Eton, later prime minister, was first expelled somewhere.
explanation.walkthrough: Eton is an elite English boarding school, so 'expulsion' sounds like being thrown out of school.
explanation.definitionFit: Eden is the biblical garden of Genesis and the surname of Sir Anthony, Conservative prime minister after Churchill.

clue.text: Long for source of needles

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to yearn
second meaning: a conifer that sheds needle-shaped leaves

explanation.surface: Someone yearns for a supplier of sewing needles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Long for' reads as one verb; here 'Long' alone is the first meaning and 'for' links.
explanation.definitionFit: To pine is to yearn, and the pine tree bears needle-shaped leaves.

clue.text: One so-called master backed something that's pupil-centred

parts.note: the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: backed means sent backwards, so the title is read right to left

parts.note: sir is the form of address used for a schoolmaster

explanation.surface: A teacher supports a child-focused approach to education.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pupil-centred' sounds like a teaching philosophy, but the pupil is the one in the eye; pupils call their teacher sir.
explanation.definitionFit: The iris is the coloured ring of the eye with the pupil at its centre.

clue.text: Start off one process of choosing or another

indicators.note: taking the start off means removing the first letter

parts.note: a selection is a choosing

explanation.surface: An instruction to begin one method of decision-making or a different one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Another' is short for another process of choosing, picking up the phrase earlier in the clue.
explanation.definitionFit: An election is choosing by vote, a second process of choosing besides selection.

clue.text: Charming language we speak, shortly before becoming mature

indicators.note: shortly means cut short, so only the opening letters of the language name stay

parts.note: the language of the British setter and solver
to age is to mature, so aging is becoming mature

explanation.surface: Our lovely tongue, said briefly before growing up.
explanation.walkthrough: ENG is the standard abbreviation of English.
explanation.definitionFit: Engaging means attractive and pleasing, a synonym of charming.
